text:
harper: Quick thread for a compact segmented onboarding flow — want a 3-email 'quickplay' that teaches one micro-action per mail and ends with a bench/webinar CTA. Keep everything code-friendly and low asset.

noah: Good. Proposed segments: dev_samples (ran examples), browse_only (docs clicks), company_lead (company email + size >30). We'll need a suppression list for recent unsubscribes.

zane: cadence idea: Q1 (day 0) welcome + 1 quick tip, Q2 (day 3) micro-benchmark + short curl snippet for dev_samples, Q3 (day 8) invite to 20-min bench walkthrough + enterprise calendar for company_lead.

claire: subject tests (Q1): "You're on the list — one quick test" vs "Start: 60s to see Redwood in action". Run test on dev_samples only.

harper: creative constraints: single small PNG for Q2 (latency vs baseline), keep <100KB and include alt text. Also prefer GIF only if <80KB.

noah: include inline code for Q2 for dev_samples:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```

Put that only in dev_samples variant.

zane: UTMs: utm_campaign=quickplay_onboard_q3, utm_content={segment}. Track events: open, click, bench_reg, trial_start. Create cohort quickplay_q3_dev for funnel tracking.

claire: send windows: dev_samples Tue 9am PT, browse_only Wed 2pm PT, company_lead Mon 11am PT. For company_lead surface `https://cal.redwood.ai/enterprise?utm_medium=email` as primary CTA.

harper: owners: noah = segment export + suppressions, claire = subject tests + creative brief, zane = send ops (Braze), me = copy + final QA.

noah: CSV format I'll drop to #marketing-assets: email,segment,company,company_size,intent_score,signup_ts,exclude_flag. ETA tomorrow 9:30am.

zane: rollout plan: Phase A = dev_samples (~3.2k). Send Q1 -> wait 24h -> if open <12% swap subject and resend; if click >=4% proceed to full cohort. Expand to browse_only after 48h.

claire: tracking detail: add mail_variant tag for A/B. Also ensure plain-text fallback present.

harper: keep each email <=120 words, single primary CTA. For high-intent (intent_score>85) replace webinar CTA with 1-click demo booking link `https://cal.redwood.ai/demo?utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=quickplay_onboard_q3`.

noah: suppression rules: exclude unsubscribed in last 90d, bounces, internal domains, and anyone who already started a trial. I'll attach suppression list with the CSV.

zane: creative ask: small 2s console GIF for Q1 hero (if within size limit). Otherwise stick to PNG icon. Provide alt text and accessible CTAs.

marketing-bot: reminder set: draft copy due Thu EOD; assets due Mon 9am. :spiral_calendar_pad:

claire: A note for legal: any claim like "50% lower cost" needs source line. we'll include a tiny footnote with test parameters in Q2.

harper: good call. include micro-footnote: "Measured on public numbers; sample workload details available on demo." Keep it terse.

noah: we'll add a Liquid block in the template to swap CTA based on segment:

```liquid
{% if recipient.segment == 'company_lead' %}
  <!-- show enterprise calendar CTA -->
{% elsif recipient.intent_score > 85 %}
  <!-- show demo booking CTA -->
{% else %}
  <!-- show webinar registration CTA -->
{% endif %}
```

zane: I'll run an internal dry send to the marketing list before Phase A. report back here after the first 24h metrics.

harper: perfect — thanks team. next check-in here after CSV drop. :rocket:
